title: Physical interpretation of substrate self-duality
html: Self-duality ensures the observer trace \Phi = \lambda \circ \mu and the observed state space are canonically paired. The algebra A acts simultaneously as the algebra of observables and the space on which those observables act. The Frobenius form \lambda is the unique trace that makes A its own dualizing object.
